title: Agent telemetry event (privacy-safe)
description: A metadata-only lifecycle event. It never contains prompt text, response text, a secret, or business content. Generic and illustrative; adapt to your runtime.

session_id.description: Randomized per session. Not derived from a username.

user_id.description: Keyed pseudonymous identifier, for example an HMAC. Never a raw or unsalted-hashed username.

tool_use_id.description: Pairs one tool request with its result.

parent_agent_id.description: Connects delegated work to the parent agent.

artifact_id.description: Connects activity to a pull request, work item, test run, or release. Only when the purpose is documented.

error_category.description: A governed, versioned category from error-categories.yaml, not a raw provider string.
